say:1:1610510001:1.text: The pigments are unusual, made from mana-infused minerals and rare plants. The canvas was treated to withstand magical energy.
say:1:1610510001:1.source_cn: 这幅画的颜料很特殊，几乎都是用亲魔法的名贵的矿石和植物...

say:2:1610510002:1.text: Even the frame and carvings are top-grade craftsmanship.
say:2:1610510002:1.source_cn: 除此之外，画框、装饰和雕刻工艺也都堪称上乘。

say:3:1610510003:1.text: No ordinary noble could afford something like this.
say:3:1610510003:1.source_cn: 仅仅这些东西，恐怕普通的贵族也负担不起。

say:5:1610510004:1.text: I'm no art expert, but there's definitely magic bound to that painting.
say:5:1610510004:1.source_cn: 我不了解绘画，但这幅画上附着了多种魔法。

say:6:1610510005:1.text: Beyond preservation spells, someone sealed a large amount of mana into it, giving the image those special features.
say:6:1610510005:1.source_cn: 除了常规的保存魔法之外，有人用一种特殊的术式将大量的魔...

say:8:1610510006:1.text: So the impact caused the mana to leak, and that's why the image vanished?
say:8:1610510006:1.source_cn: 刚才的损伤造成了画像内的魔力流失，所以这幅画的图案才消失了？

say:9:1610510007:1.text: That seems to be the case.

say:10:1610510008:1.text: To repair it, we'll need the <style="highlight">right materials</style> to mend the tear and we'll have to <style="highlight">decipher the spell used to seal the mana</style>.

say:11:1610510009:1.text: Then we can redraw the magic circle and <style="highlight">reinfuse mana</style> into the painting.
say:11:1610510009:1.source_cn: 使用对应术式绘制成魔法阵，再为这幅画<style=hi...
